title: 'Ultimate litmus test': Can the EU stand up to Trump over Greenland?
summary: EU member states are finding themselves in a “real bind” as they debate how to respond to US President Donald Trump’s tariff threats over Greenland, FRANCE 24’s Douglas Herbert said in an analysis. “This is the ultimate litmus test”, he said, adding that the issue boils down to Europe’s sovereignty and self-determination and whether it can “stand up” to Tru…
